items.title: How Singapore’s National Precision Medicine program runs population-scale SV discovery on AWS HealthOmics
items.summary: Singapore's National Precision Medicine program and the SG100K consortium built a population-scale structural variant catalog from more than 100,000 genomes using GATK-SV. The A*STAR-PRECISE team ran that community-standard pipeline on AWS HealthOmics, with results confirmed functionally equivalent to the Broad Institute reference implementation.
items.creator: Li Zhihui
